checks.model: passed — ten targeted tests: exact mass accounting, independent RK4, reviewed reference agreement, cube-root area/target-time relationships, equal/exchanged counts, record validation and supported geometry for every grain
checks.twoD: passed — labelled front slice, explicit hidden layers, common magnification, initial-size inspection references; live grain-width shrinkage and complete 110-second playback
checks.threeD: passed — every cubic model grain included, supported separated layers, common camera magnification, glass/reference water, whole and initial-reference inspection; complete 110-second playback
checks.responsive: passed — 320×740, 390×844, 820×1180, 1280×960, 1920×1080 browser viewports in theatre; 2D whole/inspection and 3D whole/inspection, no page overflow, SVG text within bounds and paired canvases within stage. Portrait font size increased for readability
checks.practicalRecord: passed — ten GUI trials including zero/end, matched times, equal counts, exchanged counts, 1000-grain limit and live manual trial; nine-trial downloaded exam report validated with actual side/area/solid/rate/mean/target substitutions; notes and ten rows persisted after reload
checks.playback: passed — full uninterrupted 110-second guides completed separately in 3D and 2D; start/pause/resume, record locks and elapsed-time preservation during inspection/reset verified
checks.cleanLoad: passed — final reload and viewer interactions produced no new warning/error logs

reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser viewport review. Not independent expert, official-board, empirical dissolution-rate or physical-device certification. Standard OrbitControls bound; pointer dragging not recorded. Full 300-second manual run was not observed; pause/resume and both complete guided playbacks were observed. Portrait label enlargement followed timed guides and was checked across responsive views without changing animation logic.
